script: Decision: excluded. The claimant reports hitting a guardrail without contacting the deer, so the loss is a collision rather than direct animal contact classified as other-than-collision. The declarations state that no collision coverage was purchased. Next action: Deny coverage for this loss because collision coverage was not purchased.
